dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular, closed-loop light grey perimeters against a dark charcoal background. The edges exhibit high contrast with a sharp step-function gradient. Specifically, three centrally located 'O' shaped annuli show convoluted, non-circular perimeters with internal dark fills.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, high-intensity white/light-grey pixel clusters located primarily near the anterior flipper insertion point and scattered along the ventral-lateral margin. These lack internal gradient and appear as solid, irregular shapes.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of three prominent dorsal macro-annuli form a wide-angled obtuse triangle, with the longest edge oriented parallel to the spinal axis. A fourth blob near the posterior flipper creates a trapezoidal relationship with the dorsal group.
